title: ticfac Phase 1: the reconciler and the local subprocess executor
description: SPEC §12 Phase 1. Create the separate ticfac repository with its own CI and ticfac run-epic <id>. Implement the tk client, Git integration command, evidence command and the restartable reconciliation loop for one epic at concurrency one — the deterministic lifecycle (claims, waves, gates, merge, boundary checks, cleanup ordering) in code. Implement the local subprocess executor through the four operations: worktree per attempt, runner launched headless, RESULT as completion contract; claude, codex and pi are runner values on this one executor. Profiles resolve to executor, runner, model, prompt only. Deliverables: ticfac repo, reconciler, subprocess executor, three profiles, restart demonstration.
notes:
2026-09-02 13:29 - INHERITED FROM 5hm (properties of the move, not of the old architecture): (1) embedded.go at the module root welds skills + cloud/factory + cloud/sandbox into ONE go:embed unit because go:embed cannot reach above its package; tk factory deploy ships that bundle baked into the binary — that is today's version pin and the hardest structural blocker. (2) cloud/factory/required-tk-commands is DERIVED by a go/ast scan of cloudTkJSON call sites in cmd/tk/cmd; if call sites move the scanner moves with them or is replaced, or the derivation test passes while scanning nothing. (3) cloud/worker is the ticks.sh BOARD, not the factory; it stays. (4) the sandbox image installs two binaries, tk and ticfac, no shim; 'tk cloud ...' becomes 'ticfac ...' and every caller incl. container entrypoints is repointed as part of the move. Also: CHANGELOG 0.32.0 is held UNRELEASED until the extraction settles what ships from where. Prior decoupling work already done under a4n: Phase 1 (3j4) cut the Go dependency, Phase 3 (9hu) split the credential file, Phase 5a (g0b) cut the last cross-repo edges — build on those, do not redo them.
2026-09-02 13:34 - LEGACY DEFECTS THAT MUST BE SOLVED BY DESIGN HERE (from epic 72y, closed as legacy 2026-09-02). Each is a required test in the Phase 1 gate or the Appendix A suite, not a fix to port:
- iu9 worker wiped on sandbox sleep -> Appendix A #5: the executor pushes in-progress work on a timer; RESULT presence is checked on origin, not in a container.
- k4r runs stuck in 'stopping' forever -> Appendix A #8: in-flight state is settled by whoever finds it next from durable evidence.
- 4qx phantom boundary violation after a worker merged the integration branch -> collect diffs the attempt branch against the attempt's recorded base SHA (in attempts/<n>.json), never against the moving target ref. Test: worker merges integration, boundary check stays clean.
- 09w boundary check conflates tracker state with project config -> the .tick/ boundary is enforced on tracker records (.tick/issues, activity) and explicitly exempts .tick/config.md, runners.toml and learnings.md, which workers may edit. Test both directions.
- 5jo agent/handle names collide across repos (tick-<id> global namespace) -> JobHandle identity is (repository coordination key, run id, tick, attempt); the Herdr executor names agents from that, never from tick id alone. Test: two repos, same tick id, concurrent.
- gm5 report lands outside the worktree when the worker cds -> the executor owns the RESULT path (absolute, inside the attempt worktree, passed in JobSpec.artifact_prefix); the worker's cwd is irrelevant. Test: worker cds to /tmp then writes RESULT.
- 5qj flaky cloud/factory vitest under load -> Phase 0 T4 (mrq) and Phase 4: compatibility tests must not depend on workerd timing; flake is a defect in the test, never a rerun.
- 201 herd dashboard truncates the epic list -> Phase 2 dashboard scrolls; cosmetic, no gate.
2026-09-02 16:52 - Also applies here (Peter, 2026-09-02): the local subprocess executor must pass the same finished-worker-detection tests as the Herdr executor (see note on jrj (a)): completion from durable evidence only, no lost-event race, re-issued waits see settled work immediately, and worktree cleanup leaves zero run-created worktrees/branches.
acceptance_criteria: Gate: one real epic on the ticks repository completes through ticfac run-epic locally with a claude or codex runner, killed and restarted after dispatch, after collection and before closure, with no duplicate work and no false success.
